ai-casebook.md.content: \text{Daily Prompts} = \text{Addressable Base} \times \text{Adoption Rate} \times \text{Daily Active Share} \times \text{Prompts per Active User}
31.4\text{ million} + 84.0\text{ million} = 115.4\text{ million prompts per day}
\text{Required GPUs} = \frac{\text{Peak Tokens per Second}}{\text{Tokens per Second per GPU}}
\text{Power Share} = \frac{\text{Total GPU Cluster Power Consumption (MW)}}{\text{Total Operational Indian Data Centre Capacity (MW)}}
\text{Annual TAM} = \text{Addressable White-Collar Workers} \times \text{Enterprise Adoption Share} \times \text{Annual Seat Price}
\text{Net Hours Saved} = \text{Junior Staff} \times \text{Annual Working Hours} \times \text{Gross Speedup} \times \text{Net Capacity Capture Rate}
\text{Human Cost/Query} = \frac{\text{Fully Loaded Agent Cost}}{\text{Monthly Resolved Volume}}
\text{AI Cost/Query} = \text{Model Token Fees} + \text{Cloud Infrastructure} + (\text{Escalation Rate} \times \text{Human Cost})
\text{Required Servers} = \frac{\text{Peak Transactions per Second} \times \text{Inference Latency per Score}}{\text{Cores per Server}}
\text{Peak Transactions per Second (TPS)} = \frac{52{,}500{,}000}{3{,}600} \approx 14{,}583\text{ TPS (round to 15,000 TPS)}
\text{Dedicated Cores at Peak} = \frac{15{,}000\text{ TPS}}{50\text{ TPS/core}} = 300\text{ dedicated compute cores}
\text{Annual Bill} = (\text{Total Terabytes Stored} \times \text{Storage Rate/TB}) + (\text{Retrieval Volume} \times \text{Egress Rate})
\text{Annual Ingestion} = 171\text{ GB} \times 365 \approx 62{,}415\text{ GB} \approx 62.4\text{ Terabytes (TB) per year}
\text{Total Capex} = \text{Land \& Core Building} + \text{Electrical Substation Infrastructure} + \text{Liquid Cooling Plant} + \text{Fit-Out Overhead}

financial-copilots-and-deal-diligence.md.content: \Delta \text{Cash} \equiv \text{Cash Flow from Operations} + \text{Cash Flow from Investing} + \text{Cash Flow from Financing}
MoIC = \frac{\text{Exit Equity Value}}{\text{Entry Equity Value}},\quad IRR = (MoIC)^{1/n} - 1
DSCR = \frac{\text{Net Operating Income}}{\text{Total Debt Service}} = \frac{\text{EBITDA} - \text{CapEx}}{\text{Principal Repayments} + \text{Interest Expenses}}

finance-casebook.md.content: \Delta PBT = \Delta \text{Provision Savings} + \Delta \text{Opex Savings} = \text{₹}30.0\text{ Cr} + \text{₹}80.0\text{ Cr} = \mathbf{\text{₹}110.0\text{ crore/year}}
\Delta ROA_{\text{pre-tax}} = \frac{\Delta PBT}{\text{AUM}} = \frac{\text{₹}110.0\text{ Cr}}{\text{₹}10{,}000\text{ Cr}} = \mathbf{+1.10\%}\quad (\mathbf{+110\text{ basis points}})
\Delta ROE = \frac{\Delta PAT}{\text{Allocated Equity}} = \frac{\text{₹}82.31\text{ Cr}}{\text{₹}1{,}000\text{ Cr}} = \mathbf{+8.23\%}\quad (\mathbf{+823\text{ basis points}})
\text{Total Enterprise Value Created} = \text{Entry Haircut (₹85 Cr)} + \text{Fee Savings (₹2.2 Cr)} + \Delta EV_{\text{exit}}\text{ (₹1,440 Cr)} = \mathbf{\text{₹}1{,}527.2\text{ crore}}
\text{Total Annual Pre-Tax Value} = \Delta \text{Payroll Savings} + \Delta \text{Fee Revenue} = \text{₹}96.0\text{ Cr} + \text{₹}13.5\text{ Cr} = \mathbf{\text{₹}109.5\text{ crore/year}}
\text{Optimized Margin} = \frac{\text{₹}313.5\text{ Cr} - \text{₹}24.0\text{ Cr}}{\text{₹}313.5\text{ Cr}} = \frac{\text{₹}289.5\text{ Cr}}{\text{₹}313.5\text{ Cr}} = \mathbf{92.3\%}

\text{Annualized On-Prem Fixed Cost} = \frac{\text{₹}12.75\text{ Cr}}{3} + \text{₹}3.89\text{ Cr} = \text{₹}4.25\text{ Cr} + \text{₹}3.89\text{ Cr} = \mathbf{\text{₹}8.14\text{ crore/year}}

V^* = \frac{\text{Annualized Fixed On-Prem Cost}}{c_{\text{API}}} = \frac{\text{₹}8{,}14{,}00{,}000}{\text{₹}0.408} \approx \mathbf{199{,}509{,}804\text{ queries/year}}\quad (\approx \mathbf{16.63\text{ million queries/month}})
\text{Total Annual Value} = \text{₹}350.0\text{ Cr (Loss Mitigation)} + \text{₹}3.75\text{ Cr (Waiver Fees)} = \mathbf{\text{₹}353.75\text{ crore/year}}
ROE_{\text{optimized}} = \frac{\text{₹}191.94\text{ Cr}}{\text{₹}1{,}000.0\text{ Cr}} = \mathbf{19.19\%}\quad (\mathbf{+482\text{ basis points ROE expansion}})
\Delta \text{Equity Value} = \text{₹}2{,}400.0\text{ Cr} - \text{₹}1{,}800.0\text{ Cr} = \mathbf{\text{₹}600.0\text{ crore}}\quad (\mathbf{+33.3\%\text{ equity market revaluation}})
